summary: One test failed due to a locator not finding the expected element on the contact form page, causing the test to fail visibility check.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator '[data-test="nav-contact"]' did not find any matching element on the page within the timeout period, indicating a possible mismatch between the selector used in the test and the actual application DOM.

failedTests.testName: TC-001: Verify accessibility of the contact form
failedTests.errorMessage: Error: expect(locator('[data-test="nav-contact"]')).toBeVisible() failed - element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' does not match any element on the contact form page, possibly due to changes in the application UI or incorrect selector in the test.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify the correctness of the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' against the current application DOM. Update the selector if the application UI has changed. If the selector is correct, investigate if the page is loading properly or if there are environment issues causing the element to not render.

recommendations: Review and update the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' in the test to match the current application UI.
Check if the application page at `${baseURL}/contact` loads correctly and contains the expected element.
Review recent application changes that might have affected the presence or attributes of the contact form element.
If the selector is confirmed correct, investigate environment stability or timing issues that might cause the element to not appear within the timeout.
releaseImpact: High - The failure indicates a broken test for a critical contact form accessibility feature, which may block release until resolved.
